newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France says fare hikes not finalised.
newsitem.headline: Air France says fare hikes not finalised.

text.p: Air France said on Friday it was considering increasing passenger fares on flights from France from Monday November 4 but new rates had yet to be finalised.
The company had earlier issued a statement detailing the price rises but then withdrew it, saying it was not final.
The first statement, linking the decision to a rise of some 40 percent in fuel costs, had detailed fare hikes on flights to European, North African, Asian, American and Middle East destinations.
It had said that it had not yet decided on the date and level of fare changes applying to French overseas territories.
